description: PGP structure spoofing: a multipart/signed message whose signed part is benign but which carries an EXTRA unsigned text/plain sibling holding the injection payload (content outside the signature scope). The pipeline verifies no signatures and elevates no trust: the benign signed part is the primary untrusted.body_text, the unsigned payload is surfaced in untrusted.alternate_parts (not meta), the signature is an attachment, and no verification warning is emitted. An agent must treat all of it as untrusted.
